title: Language Trip
summary: Spaced repetition language learning app with 60000+ words
description:
Language Trip is a fully offline language-learning app built for CardputerZero (320×170 LVGL + physical keyboard)

What It Has (Offline Content)
3 Study Languages in a local SQLite database (sprakverkstad-content.sqlite, 102.32 MiB, 201,191 total vocabulary entries):
English: 78,447 words + 45 irregular verbs (90 conjugation items)
Spanish: 61,372 words, 92 grammar lessons, CEFR A1–C2 placement test, and verb conjugation drills
Japanese: 61,372 words, 176 grammar lessons, 400 kanji (with Swedish/English glosses and Genki/JFZ/RTK alignment), hiragana/katakana drills, and verb conjugations
18 structured course stages and full-text (FTS5) offline dictionary search.
3 UI Languages: English, Swedish, and Spanish (configurable independently from the study language).
